verdicts.reason: A: the SOLSTICE logo has shrunk to an unreadable speck pushed off-centre into the top right; the headline, the subcopy (tiny one-line text) and the Shop Now button are all far too small next to an oversized can, which leaves big dead gaps and wrecks the hierarchy. B: keeps the centred logo, a large headline and a strong CTA, so the hierarchy matches the original, but the subcopy still wraps in a narrow skyscraper column and leaves 'hour.' alone on the last line, the can is small for the canvas, and there is a large empty band between the copy and the button.
